lines.en: Hi Omar! How are you feeling today?
Hi Sara! Much better, thank God. I had a headache yesterday.
Sorry to hear that. Did you see a doctor?
No, I just rested and drank a lot of water.
That's good. Are you ready for the English exam next week?
Almost. I am studying at the library every evening.
The library closes at eight, right?
Yes. After that, I study online at home.
Online? On that free website you told me about?
Exactly. It has great exercises and videos.
Send me the link on WhatsApp, please.
Sure, I will send it tonight.
By the way, how is your new smartphone?
It is very fast. But the battery dies quickly.
You should charge it every night.
I know, but I always forget.
Same here! Anyway, I went shopping yesterday.
Oh really? What did you buy?
A new jacket. It was on sale, thirty percent off.
Great deal! How much did you pay?
Only five hundred pounds. I paid by card.
Nice. I need new shoes for work.
There is a good shoe shop next to the pharmacy.
I know it. Is it expensive?
Not really. Good prices and good service.
I will go there on Friday after work.
Do you want me to come with you?
That would be great! And my sister wants to come too.
How is your sister? I heard she got married!
Yes, two months ago. She is very happy.
Congratulations! Family is everything.
Thank you, Sara. You are a good friend.
And you are a good friend too, Omar.
Okay, I have to go. My class starts in ten minutes.
Good luck with the exam!
Thanks! See you on Friday!
